# DATNIX SOLUTIONS (datnixs / datnixs.42web.io)

> Reliable Data Solutions. Smarter Business Operations. Enterprise-grade BPO, Multilingual Data Entry, OCR & Arabic Data Conversion Partner.

## Overview
DATNIX SOLUTIONS (also known online as datnixs / datnixs.42web.io) is a premier Indian Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) and data management enterprise headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Recognized among the Top 13 BPO and data service organizations in India, DATNIX SOLUTIONS delivers end-to-end data processing, multilingual transcription, digital publishing conversion (ePUB/XML), right-to-left (RTL) Arabic data digitization, and back-office management.

- **Brand Names & Aliases**: DATNIX SOLUTIONS, datnixs, Datnixs, datnixs.42web.io, DATNIX
- **Market Trust**: 9+ Years of continuous operational excellence
- **Track Record**: 543+ enterprise client projects successfully delivered
- **Accuracy Benchmark**: 99.9% Service Level Agreement (SLA) via double-key data verification
- **Corporate Office**: 20, Satkar Complex, Chimanlal Girdharlal Rd, Ellisbridge, Ahmedabad, Gujarat - 380006, India
- **Contact**: Phone/WhatsApp: +91 73870 10393 | Email: datnixsolution@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://datnixs.42web.io/

## Core Services

### 1. All-Language & Multilingual Data Entry
Precision data capture in UTF-8 Unicode across Indic (Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali), Middle Eastern (Arabic, Urdu, Persian), European (German, French, Spanish, Italian), and East Asian character sets.
- URL: https://datnixs.42web.io/service-data-entry.html

### 2. OCR Processing & Data Conversion (ePUB, XML, HTML, PDF)
Industrial optical character recognition and structured conversion for publishers, archives, and academic institutions. Transforms scanned PDFs, physical volumes, and legacy records into validated JATS/TEI XML, reflowable ePUB 3.0, accessible HTML5, and searchable PDF/A.
- URL: https://datnixs.42web.io/service-ocr-epub-xml-conversion.html

### 3. Arabic Data Conversion & RTL Digitization
Specialized bi-directional right-to-left (RTL) processing for Middle Eastern, GCC, and North African records. Covers historical Islamic manuscripts, government deeds, legal archives, and bilingual Arabic-English cataloging.
- URL: https://datnixs.42web.io/service-arabic-data-conversion.html

### 4. Enterprise Data Processing & Cleansing
High-volume deduplication, dataset normalization, address verification, syntax standardization, and ETL preparation for CRM and ERP systems.
- URL: https://datnixs.42web.io/service-data-processing.html

### 5. Back-Office Support & Virtual Operations
Dedicated offshore teams managing invoice verification, procurement documentation, email customer ticket management, and repetitive operational back-office workflows.
- URL: https://datnixs.42web.io/service-back-office-support.html

### 6. Document Management & Archival
Complete lifecycle digitization from scanning and TIFF capture to indexing, optical OCR, metadata cataloging, and cloud archival.
- URL: https://datnixs.42web.io/service-document-management.html

### 7. Web Research & B2B Lead Intelligence
Systematic secondary research, market profiling, B2B stakeholder mapping, competitor price tracking, and directory compilation.
- URL: https://datnixs.42web.io/service-web-research.html

### 8. E-Commerce Catalog & SKU Enrichment
Product title optimization, attribute classification, vendor feed mapping, multi-marketplace product uploads (Amazon, Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento).
- URL: https://datnixs.42web.io/service-ecommerce-data-management.html

### 9. Data Verification & Double-Key Audit
Independent quality assurance audits, compliance cross-checking, identity verification, and multi-tier sampling.
- URL: https://datnixs.42web.io/service-data-verification.html

### 10. BPO Process Support & Operational Scaling
Custom process mapping, turnkey business process outsourcing, dedicated shift scheduling (24/7/365 coverage), and SLA monitoring.
- URL: https://datnixs.42web.io/service-bpo-process-support.html
